S: the Grandmaster's colourful palace on Sakaar
Bright fruit skewers of watermelon, kiwi, pineapple and dragonfruit, with a lime, honey and chilli drizzle.
the gentle rock man with the New Zealand accent
Sausage mince with grated onion, carrot and herbs rolled in puff pastry, egg washed, sesame on top, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Tomato sauce.
Scrapper 142, aka Valkyrie, and her love of a drink

Squid strips dusted in rice flour, salt, Sichuan pepper and chilli, fried crisp and tossed with fried garlic and spring onion, with lime mayo. Cut 600g cleaned squid tubes into strips and pat dry. Mix 100g rice flour with 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground Sichuan pepper and half a teaspoon of chilli powder. Toss the squid through. Fry in batches at 190C for 60 to 90 seconds until crisp and pale golden. Fry 4 sliced garlic cloves and 1 sliced red chilli for 30 seconds and toss through with spring onion. Mix 100g mayonnaise with lime juice to dip.
M: Lamb shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and lemon, roasted at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart, with roast potatoes and mint yoghurt.
Asgardian roast beef rib with Yorkshires

A bone-in beef rib roasted to pink and carved at the table, with tall Yorkshire puddings, crisp potatoes, roast carrots and red wine gravy. Season a 2kg beef rib roast and roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 160C for about 60 minutes to 52C inside. Rest 25 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes and 500g carrots in hot oil at 220C while the beef rests. Whisk 3 eggs, 150ml milk and 120g plain flour, pour into a smoking oiled 12-hole tin and bake 20 minutes. Simmer the tray juices with 1 tbsp flour, 150ml red wine and 300ml beef stock for gravy.
W: Crunchy chocolate cornflake biscuits topped with chocolate icing and a walnut. Beat 200g butter with 100g sugar, add 180g flour, 2 tbsp cocoa and 50g cornflakes.
K: Never-empty mug of honey lager punch
the beer Doctor Strange gives Thor that keeps refilling

Cold lager mixed by the jug with honey ginger syrup, fresh lemon and a splash of apple juice, poured into big mugs and topped up all night. Simmer 80g honey, 80ml water and a sliced thumb of ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. In a large chilled jug mix the syrup with the juice of 2 lemons and 200ml cloudy apple juice. Slowly pour in 6 bottles of cold lager and stir gently once. Pour into big mugs with a lemon wheel and keep a second jug ready to top them up.

s.note: the Grandmaster's colourful palace on Sakaar
s.how: Cut a quarter watermelon, 2 kiwifruit, a quarter pineapple and a dragonfruit into chunks and thread onto skewers. Drizzle with lime juice, honey and a pinch of chilli. Arrange in a rainbow.

s.note: the gentle rock man with the New Zealand accent
s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with a grated onion and carrot and herbs. Roll in 2 sheets puff pastry, egg wash, sprinkle with sesame and cut into 16. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve warm with plenty of tomato sauce for dipping.

m.how: Rub a 1.8kg lamb shoulder with 4 garlic cloves, rosemary and lemon. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with chopped mint to serve.

w.how: Beat 200g butter with 100g sugar, add 180g flour, 2 tbsp cocoa and 50g cornflakes. Bake 16 mounds at 180C for 14 minutes. Ice with 150g icing sugar mixed with 1 tbsp cocoa and water, and top each with half a walnut.
